thread:
incident-bot: Pager: P0 - model-warmup failures causing elevated 5xxs on inference nodes in us-west-2. Affected service: inference-runtime. Pager details: multiple OOMs at model load + CUDA compile timeouts.
elaine: I'm on it. jumping in to triage. can someone grab the customer impact?
sam: seeing a flurry of container restarts on node pool 'infer-prod-4' — logs show `std::bad_alloc` during tensor deserialization.
mike: cuda logs: `cuModuleLoadDataEx returned CUDA_ERROR_NO_BINARY_FOR_GPU` then subsequent `cuLaunchKernel` failures. also some `nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo` shows rapid memory climb pre-oom.
ryan: repro steps from node: `docker run -e REDWOOD_MODEL_PATH=/models/gpt-xl:latest ./runtime warmup --batch=8 --seq=2048` — fails consistently during deserialization stage.
elaine: immediate mitigation suggestion: pin warmup to smaller batch and lower seq, and disable JIT compile for the load path while we investigate. can we patch a quick config change?
sam: I can push a soft rollback: set `WARMUP_BATCH=1` and `WARMUP_SEQ=512` via runtime config, and toggle `JIT_COMPILE=false` in the deployment. will deploy to canary nodes first.
incident-bot: Deploy triggered by sam: canary=2/10 nodes — rolling deploy started. ETA ~2m per node.
mike: also seeing `deserialize: invalid header` on some artifacts — looks like partial artifact truncation on the NFS mount. checksum mismatch on model shard 3/12.
nicole: support-bot: Customer-impact snapshot: ~4% of hosted API requests in us-west-2 are returning 5xx, mostly token-generation requests with longer context (>1024). Top affected customers flagged and paging CS.
ryan: trying to replicate locally with bad shard — `sha256sum` mismatch indeed. I can pull from S3 and rehydrate the corrupted shard. might be an artifact push issue during the last deploy window.
elaine: ok plan: 1) finish canary with downgraded warmup settings; 2) if stable, roll to remaining nodes; 3) replace corrupted shard from S3 and restart affected containers; 4) run artifact verification on deploy pipeline and add retry on artifact fetch.
sam: canary completed on 2 nodes, no new OOMs reported after toggles. rolling to remaining 8 nodes now.
incident-bot: Rolling deploy progress: 5/10 nodes updated. No new OOM alerts in updated nodes.
mike: I still see compile timeouts on older nodes trying to JIT kernels for A100-sm86. stack: `cuBLAS initialize -> ptgmm compile timeout` then fallback fails. Those nodes haven't picked up the JIT toggle yet.
elaine: prioritize rolling those nodes first. also limit background evicted jobs to free memory: `kubectl cordon` + `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` on hot nodes as temporary measure.
ryan: replacing shard from S3 now on two nodes. restart in sequence. Patch script: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-models/gpt-xl/shard-03.bin /models/gpt-xl/shard-03.bin && sync && chown runtime:runtime ...`
nicole: support-bot: Updating customers in the affected cohort: CS notified via DM and temporary status post created. ETA for resolution estimate: 35-45m — marking as 'partial degradation' on status page.
sam: rolled the remaining nodes, 10/10 updated. monitoring shows 5xxs trending down. latency back to normal for short-context requests.
mike: shard replacement done on 3 nodes. those nodes cleared without restart issues.
elaine: monitoring: error rate down from 4% to ~0.3% in us-west-2. continuing watch. I'll keep the incident open for postmortem.
incident-bot: Automated severity update: impact reduced. Reminder to follow up with postmortem template in #postmortems within 72h.
ryan: suspected root causes: 1) artifact push produced a truncated shard (network/glacier retry glitch), 2) JIT compile exposed hardware-specific kernel binary incompatibility on older infra images, 3) warmup used aggressive batch/seq values causing memory amplification during deserialization.
nicole: logged customer RCA note into incident tracker and flagged top-3 impacted tenants for credits discussion.
sam: follow-ups I can own: add artifact sha verification to runtime startup, add automatic fallback to model-serve in CPU-only safe-mode when GPU compile fails, and add warmup guardrails per model size.
mike: infra follow-ups: ensure driver/kernel matrix gating in deploy pipeline, add a short-circuit to skip JIT compile if `cuModuleLoadDataEx` reports NO_BINARY_FOR_GPU.
elaine: oncall handoff: i'm handing to sam for the rest of the night. sam — you're the incident lead for the twilight shift, please @pager if anything regresses.
sam: taking handoff. will keep watch for next 2 hours, then hand to ryan for morning. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Handoff logged: previous_owner=elaine, new_owner=sam, handoff_ts=2468102410.
support-bot: Status page updated: us-west-2 partial degradation -> investigating -> partial degradation (mitigations applied).
elaine: saving quick log snippets for postmortem: `deserialize: corrupt shard checksum`, `cuModuleLoadDataEx NO_BINARY_FOR_GPU`, `ptgmm compile timeout`, `std::bad_alloc` during KV-cache allocation.
ryan: adding the logs to the incident ticket and creating a small test-corpus to validate warmup settings across model sizes.
sam: closing note before I take over: we successfully mitigated impact and rolled a fix, but need pipeline and artifact hardening. postponing model upgrades until we have driver-image gating.
elaine: thanks team — great coordination. I'll draft the postmortem and link action items.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Please escalate if errors rise above threshold.
